integrity.claim_basis: Exact Floquet reduction plus explicit compact resonant eigenfunctions; finite code checks are corroborative only.

scientific_limitations: The spectral classification is for the unit-edge, all-zero-phase, delta-zero standard Kirchhoff member of the cited loop-chain family.
Unequal lengths, nonzero quasi-delta parameters, magnetic phases, and added periodic potentials are not covered.
The literature search cannot exclude an older equivalent calculation under different terminology for the same periodic pendant-loop graph.
title: Exact band and flat-band spectrum of the equilateral Kirchhoff loop chain
